name: Two-column pediment portico
parts: two Tuscan columns with entasis, torus bases, necking, echinus and abacus
architrave, plain frieze, dentil band and cornice with side returns
shallow triangular pediment with raking cornice
louvered oval vent in the tympanum
slate-clad roof planes with ridge cap
style: Colonial Revival entry portico, white painted wood Tuscan order, slate roof, damp and flaking paint at the column feet, moss on the stone
summary: Colonial Revival two-column portico, 3.4 m: Tuscan columns on a stone stylobate, dentil entablature, pediment, slate roof.
